item.title: The Real Reason 90% of Dealer Listings Don't Sell Cars | Industry Spotlight
item.description: In this episode of the Industry Spotlight, joining host Sam D'Arc are Shawn Dennis, Marketing Director of the Ron Marhoffer Auto Group, and Patrick Janes, AVP of Inventory Solutions at vAuto to discuss why more than 90 percent of vehicle listings fail to sell themselves , and what it actually takes to merchandise a car the right way in 2026. Shawn breaks down why proper merchandising, accurate options, a clean Carfax, real angles, video and walk arounds, takes three to four hours per car and functions as a full time job on its own. Patrick shares how his team traces stalled listings back to the exact moment a shopper clicks away , and how a new AI powered health score now audits every photo and description across a dealer group before a performance manager even picks up the phone. At Shawn's five stores, that shift already lets a merchandising staff of two keep pace with roughly 1,200 vehicles a month, freeing him to spend his time on the details a machine still can't catch, like the real story behind a one owner trade in. item.title: Why Saving $300,000 Started With a Crashed Loaner Car | Industry Spotlight
item.description: Jonathan Kienle's team once sent a salesperson to chase down a customer's canceled check, and he crashed the loaner car doing it, and Kienle says that single moment is exactly why he stopped trusting cash, checks, and credit cards to handle his dealership's biggest transactions. item.description: Laddie Stern is the Founder of Stern Auto Group, a 20-store empire he has built over 65 years in the car business.
